sc_statement: Account access uses device checks and second-factor prompts. Sensitive actions are logged, and balances are recorded in the ledger. Card and other regulated services are pre-launch. Independent certifications have not been completed.
sc_list_aria: Frameworks relevant to tazdan and where each one stands
sc_fw_soc2_d: Independent audit of security, availability and confidentiality controls.
sc_fw_soc2_body: tazdan has not had a SOC 2 audit and holds no SOC 2 report. If one is completed, it will be listed here.
sc_fw_pci_d: The card industry's security standard for handling card data.
sc_fw_pci_body: Card top-ups are designed to use hosted payment forms from external PCI DSS service providers. Card numbers would be entered with those providers, not stored by tazdan. tazdan does not hold a PCI DSS certification, and card top-ups are not live.
sc_fw_iso_body: tazdan is not ISO 27001 certified. If a certificate is issued, its details will be published here.
sc_fw_gdpr_d: EU privacy rules for personal data, which apply to users in the EU.
sc_fw_gdpr_body: Our Privacy Policy describes how personal data is handled. GDPR and local data protection laws may apply depending on the user and jurisdiction. You can request access, correction or deletion through support.
sc_fw_aml_d: Identity checks, sanctions screening and transaction monitoring.
sc_fw_aml_body: The app includes identity checks, screening and transaction-monitoring flows. Activation of these controls depends on the operating deployment and its provider arrangements.
sc_fw_lic_d: Authorisation to hold and move customer money.
sc_fw_lic_body: tazdan is not a licensed bank and does not yet hold a money transmission licence. Regulated services require the relevant authorisations and operating partners before launch; licence details will be published if granted.
scp_sub: How tazdan protects accounts, money and data today, and what hasn't been independently verified yet. Where something isn't done, this page says so.
scp_ops_d: The platform includes automated checks, privileged-action logs and controls for sensitive operations. Additional independent assurance is planned. The exact controls available to users depend on the operating deployment.
scp_fw_d: The frameworks that matter for a money app like tazdan, and where each one stands today.
scp_pay_d: Card top-ups are designed around hosted payment forms from external service providers. Card details would be entered there, and a deposit would be credited only after verification of the provider response. Card top-ups are not live.
scp_pay_3_d: A deposit credits only after the provider's signature checks out.
scp_acct_d: The mechanisms that protect every account. The trust page explains each one in more depth.
scp_acct_link: How your money is actually held
scp_priv_d: Our Privacy Policy describes how personal data is handled. Identity verification flows are built into the app and may rely on external providers when deployed.
scp_gap_d: A security page that lists only strengths isn't much use. This is what hasn't happened yet.
scp_gap_4: Required licences have not yet been granted.
scp_vuln_d: If you find a security issue, email security@tazdan.com with enough detail to reproduce it: the URL or endpoint, the steps, and the impact. Please report it privately and give us time to fix it before publishing.
scp_do_1: Report privately before any public disclosure
scp_do_2: Share a minimal proof of concept only
scp_do_3: Give us reasonable time to fix before publishing
scp_dont_2: Access or change other people's data or money
scp_dont_3: Use denial of service, social engineering or physical attacks
scp_cta_d: Email security@tazdan.com, or reach support through the contact page.
